run_Subprocess: run a command in a subprocess and capture its stdout and stderr output
get_GetTestExecutablePath: get the absolute path of a test binary given its name and build directory
set_SetEnvVar: set or unset an environment variable to a given value for test configuration
get_GetTempDir: get a temporary directory path that is automatically cleaned up at program exit
get_GetExitStatus: get the exit status code from the result of os.system command execution
